title: PORT-BRANCH-passkeys-1: carry passkeys-1 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `passkeys-1` at f954ef5fa7 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: dashboard/worker.js, site/passkeys.js, site/worker.js)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried passkeys-1
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried passkeys-1

**Evidence:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried -> passkeys-1: archived at f954ef5fa7 (refs/archive/passkeys-1): superseded: main holds 247 of the 255 code lines it added (BRANCH-SWEEP-4)


**Relapse:** 2026-11-21T13:11:19Z closing probe failed again: passkeys-1: archived at f954ef5fa7 (refs/archive/passkeys-1): port: main lacks 14 of the 255 code lines it added (site/passkeys.js: 11, dashboard/worker.js: 1,  (reopen 1; closes again only after 2 passes over 60 minutes)

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 142.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
